name: Default
shortDescription: Web-based administration and development platform for PostgreSQL, with a query tool, schema browser, backups and server dashboards.

alerts.message: Sign in with PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL (admin@example.com unless you change it before the first deploy) and the generated PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD. Both only create the first account on the first start; change them later from the pgAdmin UI. No database is included: add your PostgreSQL servers from the UI.
